Per funded lot of the whole run (2016-01-04 → 2026-10-29, 5 bps, 11%). The engine fills the whole $100k at the first printed trade after the decision (no partial fills, queue or impact); a fill bar is that minute bar (price × volume). "$100k ÷ median minute $" uses all regular-session minutes of the training / test window. "Feasible at 10%" is min($100k, 10% of the fill bar's dollar volume): what a 10% participation cap would have allowed on that one bar (report-only; not simulated). "Opening-trade exits" filled at a session's first trade through the stop; "minute open through stop" at an intraday minute that opened through it. A sparse session has fewer than 300 regular-session minute bars.
